user_question: Calculate mean elevation for the State College census tracts using elevation data at 30-meter resolution or finer.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate mean elevation for the State College census tracts using elevation data at 30-meter resolution or finer.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve census tract dataset
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a registered census-tract polygon dataset covering the State College boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked available dataset candidate that represents census tracts and covers the State College boundary. Runtime inspection must verify the candidate's spatial coverage and suitability before downstream use.

workflow_steps.title: Clip census tracts to State College boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Restrict the retrieved census-tract polygons to the supplied State College boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Clip candidate_census_tracts using input_3 as the clipping boundary. Execute only after runtime inspection confirms compatible CRS and valid geometries for both vector inputs.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the mean elevation within each State College census tract using elevation data at 30-meter resolution.
workflow_steps.instructions: Use input_2, the supplied 30-meter GeoTIFF, as the elevation raster and state_college_census_tract_zones as the polygon zones. Calculate the mean elevation for each census tract and return the tract identifiers with their mean elevation values. Do not substitute input_1 unless runtime control determines that input_2 is unavailable or unsuitable and the user requirement is explicitly revised, because input_1 is 90-meter data.

requirements.scope: The retrieved candidate dataset must contain census-tract polygons covering the supplied State College boundary.
The retrieved census-tract layer and input_3 must have compatible coordinate reference systems before clipping.
The retrieved census-tract layer must have valid polygon geometries before clipping.
The elevation raster used for the final zonal statistics must have pixel resolution no coarser than 30 meters.
The selected elevation raster and clipped census-tract zones must have matching or compatible coordinate reference systems for zonal statistics.
The selected elevation raster must spatially cover the clipped census-tract zones.
